3. The applicant is a Desk Officer in Home Department of State of Maharashtra.

According to the
prosecution, the complainant, who is a Dentist, got acquainted with the present applicant and other
co-accused through his sister, who is a social worker.

4.  According to the complainant, on 20 September 2020, he had received Whats App message from co-accused Vikas Shinde, who according to the complainant, at the relevant time was Personal Assistant to one of the Ministers in Government of Maharashtra.

According to the complainant, on the very same day,
at about 10:00 p.m. through conference phone call, the present applicant and other co-accused Vikas Shinde and Shreya Chavan had told him to immediately arrange Rs.1 crore as according to them there was a lot of competition for the said post.
According to the complainant, he believed upon the words of applicant and other co-accused and paid them Rs.1,06,00,000/-.
According to him, the present applicant and other co-accused thereafter gave him order nominating as Director bearing national emblem.

According to the complainant, when he did not get any office or other facility as assured by the applicant and co-accused, he started making inquiry and found that the order was forged and he was duped.
5. I have heard the learned senior counsel for the applicant and the learned APP for the respondent-State and the learned counsel for the complainant.
6. The learned senior counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has nothing to do with the alleged crime.
It is submitted that 913-ABA-92-22.odt according to the complainant himself, he had given the alleged amount to the co-accused.
It is submitted that nothing is to be recovered from the applicant and thus there is no need of custodial interrogation.
7. I have perused the papers of investigation.

8. Admittedly, the applicant is government servant.
If according to the applicant, he was not involved in the alleged crime, then there was no reason for him to send the above messages to the complainant who is neither his relative nor his friend.
There is a material in the form of phone call conversations between the applicant and other co-accused.
In my view, there is enough material to infer the involvement of the present applicant 913-ABA-92-22.odt in the alleged crime.
